correctness.rationale: The second MINRES iterate has x^(2)=c_0 b+c_1 Ab. Solving its normal equations and expanding spectral moments pairwise gives c_1<0 and theta=c_0/(-c_1) as an exact positive-weight average of pairwise eigenvalue sums, hence theta>=2mu. Therefore x^(2)=beta(theta I-A)b is entrywise nonnegative on a Stieltjes matrix when L<=2mu. The diagonal three-mode family yields the exact threshold formula for theta<kappa and the displayed kappa=4 negative coordinate. In dimension two the Krylov space reaches the exact solution by the second step. Independent exact arithmetic reproduced c_0=243/200, c_1=-67/200 and x_3^(2)=-1/80.

final_claim: For unpreconditioned MINRES from zero on SPD Stieltjes systems, kappa<=2 guarantees nonnegative first and second iterates for every b>=0; every kappa>2 has a three-dimensional diagonal second-iterate sign failure, and dimensions one and two are positivity-safe because MINRES terminates by step two.
